limitations: Overall listing score is 4.2/5 from five reviews; four five-star reviews and one one-star review. Selected testimonials are individual five-star reviews, not the overall rating.
Yell has an old 4.0/four-review cached rendition. Live browser listing and more recent search result both show 4.2/five reviews and the 17 Aug 2026 review.

Eight 800x800 original gallery renditions preserved, with their source borders, embedded before/after labels and proportions. Do not create new before/after pairs unless the original collage explicitly labels them.
Image 4 and 7 show before-cleaning conditions; use as labelled project context rather than hero images.
No independently verified ownership permission for a public official website; these are personalised proposal-demo assets from the business listing.
No public email found. Enquiry form should remain an honest local demo preview; WhatsApp and call are published contact routes.
The listing mentions eight years experience in legacy copy. Avoid an exact years-in-business claim in current demo.
